excerpt:
CSET’s Jacob Feldgoise, Kyle Miller, and Hanna Dohmen dove deep into investigating how location verification methods can—and cannot—improve enforcement of export controls on powerful AI chips, culminating in their report. I sat down with Jacob to learn more about the issue, their findings, and what those findings mean for mitigating AI chip smuggling.

The post Should We Track AI Chips? appeared first on Center for Security and Emerging Technology.
